correctness.rationale: The expectation after uniform-with-replacement column draws is a sum of seven plane-geometric-series terms minus twice seven line terms plus eight zero-subspace terms from Möbius inversion in the binary rank-three subspace lattice. Every 3x7 binary generator matrix corresponds to one of C(14,7)=3432 eight-vector column profiles; exactly 2696 are full rank. Independent exact-Fraction enumeration of ALL 2696 rank-three profiles and multiplicity weights gives 42 distinct rational expectation levels across 11811 labeled [7,3] codes, mean 509611/78740 and variance 759156664/232499535. The unique simplex profile has 47/12; exactly 42 missing/duplicated nonzero-point profiles give 17/4, amounting to 630 labeled codes after dividing the 168 row-basis changes. Independent information-set formula and source direct 8^7 ordered-matrix verifier are checked as separate routes. This is a finite exact census, not an infinite code-family extrapolation.
